Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — IPRoyal and ScraperAPI share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose IPRoyal only if your buying job matches “Residential proxies from $1.75/GB — ISP/datacenter/mobile lines; traffic that never expire” rather than ScraperAPI's shape. Choose ScraperAPI only if your buying job matches “Managed scraping API — Free 1,000 credits; Hobby $49/mo ($44.10 annual); 7-day trial with ” rather than IPRoyal's shape. Workflow advantage differs because IPRoyal is shaped for Residential proxies from $1.75/GB — ISP/datacenter/mobile lines; traff whereas ScraperAPI is shaped for Managed scraping API — Free 1,000 credits; Hobby $49/mo ($44.10 annual. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — IPRoyal and ScraperAPI share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
